prompt.en: why did wukong think the monster was from heaven?
prompt.zh: 为什么悟空认为那个怪物来自天堂？

choices.en: the monster said he was from heaven.
choices.zh: 那个怪物说他来自天堂。

"He must be from Heaven. I'll go up there now to see if any spirits are missing."
